Shader compiler path and disk cache
R1: Standalone libkbase on both phones: hand-built command stream, dma-heap import, fences, 10k submits, injected fault decoded
R2: Compiled-shader triangle through a zero-copy present at refresh rate
R3: Own Vulkan ICD: vkcube and dEQP-VK api/pipeline/renderpass at 95 % or more on v11 and v13
R4: Vulkan 1.3 and the DXVK feature set. A DXVK title reaches a menu
R5: Emulated geometry, tessellation and transform feedback. Target title matches oracle screenshots
R6: Target title on the G615 phone at least as good as the bridge, with fewer frames over 50 ms. Steam UI at least as good on both phones
R7: vkd3d-proton title in gameplay, 2 h soak, 10-title matrix
